study.title: Lightweight Deep Learning Models for High-Precision Rice Seedling Segmentation from UAV-Based Multispectral Images.
study.short_title: LW-Segnet/LW-Unet for Rice Seedling Segmentation (UAV MS)

segmentation.domain: crop (rice seedling stand + row segmentation, binary)
segmentation.best_model: LW-Segnet for stand extraction (best pre/recall/IoU/F1 on all 3 cultivars); LW-Unet for seedling row extraction and inference speed (143.3 FPS)

dataset.name: Rice seedling dataset (3 cultivars YX054/LF203/WN145, Harbin, Heilongjiang)
dataset.note: DJI Phantom 4 Multispectral, 6 sensors (1 RGB + 5 monochrome bands), ~3,400 frames/flight, 85%/80% forward/side overlap, FLAASH atmospheric correction; GSD 30 mm @70 m, 25 mm @50 m, 20 mm @30 m (flights at 30/50/70 m); original ortho 8,076x27,058 px subdivided into 1,300 images of 512x512 (input), augmented; split 6:1:3 train/val/test -> 6,000/1,000/3,000 (YX054 2,280/380/1,140, LF203 1,980/330/990, WN145 1,740/290/870); binary rice-seedling/row versus background; manual smoothing/connecting of seedling rows for GT.

segmentation.backbone: Lightweight hybrid attention + spatial pyramid dilated convolution (LHA-SSPDC), depthwise separable conv (no VGG16)

mIoU.ambiguity: Per-variety stand-extraction IoU% for LW-Segnet: YX054 83.42, LF203 85.45, WN145 87.06. Reported value = mean of the 3 (derived). For seedling ROW extraction LW-Unet is best: 84.28/86.43/87.42.

F1.ambiguity: Reported value = LW-Segnet stand-extraction F1 mean across 3 cultivars (0.88, 0.87, 0.92). For row extraction LW-Unet best (F1 0.87/0.86/0.89). No single headline F1 given; task- and cultivar-specific.

PA.ambiguity: Precision/recall reported per cultivar; accuracy (A) metric listed but no aggregate OA value extractable.

weed_F1.ambiguity: No weed class; rice seedling/row versus background.

crop_F1.ambiguity: Binary stand/extraction F1 captured under F1.

fps.quote: LW-Unet 143.3 FPS, LW-Segnet 117.5 FPS; MANet slowest 65.3
fps.ambiguity: Inference on DESKTOP GPU (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 2080 16 GB, Ryzen 7 5800X, TensorFlow/Keras); not measured on embedded/UAV hardware. Authors note 'potential for real-time applications' and future edge/UAV integration.

params_M.ambiguity: Structural comparison metric (LW-Unet; LW-Segnet 11.0). Reported here as structural indicator for non-edge study.

gflops.ambiguity: Structural complexity metric (LW-Unet; LW-Segnet 36.8). GPU memory: LW-Unet 603.7 MB, LW-Segnet 693.4 MB training.

issues: Accuracy metrics are variety- and task-specific (stand vs row extraction); no single headline mIoU/F1/PA; reported mIoU/F1 are derived means (flagged).
Inference speed on desktop GPU, not embedded hardware; edge.reported=false.
